name: Research Report
description: General research report with findings and analysis

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: Concise overview of key findings and conclusions. Summarize the most important discoveries, their implications, and recommended next steps in a brief, scannable format.

sections.title: Background & Context
sections.purpose: Provide the context and background information necessary to understand the research. Include the research question, motivation, and any relevant historical or situational context.

sections.title: Methodology
sections.purpose: Describe the research approach, data sources consulted, search strategies used, and any criteria applied for evaluating and filtering information.

sections.title: Key Findings
sections.purpose: Present the most important findings from the research. Only include findings with a confidence score of 0.7 or higher. Each finding should be clearly stated with supporting evidence.

sections.title: Detailed Analysis
sections.purpose: Provide in-depth analysis of the findings, exploring relationships between data points, identifying patterns, and drawing evidence-based conclusions. Include visual representations where data supports charting.

sections.title: Supporting Data
sections.purpose: Present raw data, statistics, tables, and supplementary evidence that backs up the key findings and detailed analysis sections.

sections.title: Limitations & Caveats
sections.purpose: Acknowledge any limitations of the research, gaps in data, potential biases, and caveats that the reader should be aware of when interpreting the findings.

sections.title: Sources & References
sections.purpose: List all sources consulted during the research, including URLs, publication dates, author information, and credibility assessments where available.
